detail.title: Quantum Scrambling and the Emergence of Objective Records
detail.summary: Revised analysis integrating primary and peer-reviewed sources to evaluate how quantum scrambling, environmental decoherence, and effective accessibility thresholds jointly govern the emergence and retrieval of redundant objective records.
